status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 50% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Aleppo.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 50 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Aleppo.

summary.en: US officials are discussing a military training and demining mission for Syrian forces while a budget shortfall threatens the chemical weapons watchdog’s work in Syria. Israeli forces shelled farmland in Quneitra province and raided southern Syria, wounding Syrian soldiers, and a drone strike in western Sweida injured four Syrian internal security personnel. Syrian security forces arrested suspects after a robbery at a Homs church, including a church guard, and also detained a fraud and sorcery suspect in Rif Dimashq. Survivors of chemical attacks gathered in The Hague to seek justice. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: US-offiserer diskuterer et militært trenings‑ og mineryddingsoppdrag for syriske styrker mens et budsjettunderskudd truer kjemivåpenkontrollens arbeid i Syria. Israelske styrker skjøt på jordbruksområder i provinsen Quneitra og gjennomførte raid i sørlige Syria, hvor syriske soldater ble såret, og et droneram i vestlige Sweida påførte fire syriske interne sikkerhetsansatte skader. Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker arresterte mistenkte etter et ran på en kirke i Homs, inkludert en kirkegarde, og fengslet også en mistenkt for svindel og trolldom i Rif Dimashq. Overlevende fra kjemiske angrep samlet seg i Haag for å søke rettferdighet. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
